findings.title: [P1] Return the declared `id` property
findings.body: For any call where a row is found, `loadUser` now returns `{ userId, name }` while `User` (declared one line above, `src/users.ts:7`) requires `id: string`. Every existing consumer reading `result.id` now gets `undefined`, and the object literal no longer satisfies `Promise<User>` — standard `tsc` rejects it for the missing required property `id` (and the excess `userId`). Restore `id: row.id` or update the `User` type and all its consumers together.
